SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CENTRAL GOODS AND SERVICES TAX ACT, 2017
Notice Reference No: SCN/MH/2023/1313 | Date of Notice: 25-10-2023
GSTIN: 27WWWXX9012W1Z8 | Legal Name: M/s Western Auto Components
Financial Year: 2018-19

1. Background & Audit Scrutiny: M/s Western Auto Components (hereinafter referred to as the 'taxable person') holds GST registration under the Maharashtra GST jurisdiction. During statutory audit of financial statements and monthly returns filed for the Financial Year 2018-19, the audit team examined the dates of filing Form GSTR-3B returns vis-a-vis input tax credit claimed under Section 16 of the CGST Act, 2017.

2. Examination of Return Filing Dates & Disallowance: As per Section 16(4) of the CGST Act, 2017, a registered person shall not be entitled to take input tax credit in respect of any invoice or debit note after the due date of furnishing of the return under Section 39 for the month of September following the end of financial year (i.e. 20th October 2019 for FY 2018-19). Examination of portal data shows that the taxpayer filed Form GSTR-3B for October 2018 on 15th November 2020, claiming ITC of Rs. 3,20,000/- long after the statutory cut-off date.

3. Discrepancy & Ineligible ITC Computation Table:
Return Period | GSTR-3B Due Date | Actual Filing Date | Ineligible ITC Claimed (Rs.) | CGST (Rs.) | SGST (Rs.) | Total Disallowance (Rs.)
October 2018 | 20-10-2019 | 15-11-2020 | 3,20,000/- | 1,60,000/- | 1,60,000/- | 3,20,000/-

4. Statutory Provisions & Failure: By taking ITC after the statutory deadline prescribed under Section 16(4), the taxable person has contravened the provisions of Section 16(4) read with Rule 36 of the CGST Rules, 2017. The input tax credit amounting to Rs. 3,20,000/- is therefore rendered illegal, irregular, and liable to be recovered under Section 73(1).

5. Tax, Interest & Penalty Proposal: In view of the above contravention, the taxable person is called upon to show cause why ineligible ITC of Rs. 3,20,000/- should not be recovered under Section 73(1), along with interest under Section 50(1) and penalty under Section 73(9) of the CGST Act, 2017.

6. Written Submission & Personal Hearing Directions: The taxable person is required to submit a point-wise reply to this notice within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt. A personal hearing is scheduled on 28-11-2023 at the Office of the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax.
